role: The Thread Sanitizer gate's canary: an XCTest that performs unsynchronized writes from many threads when EMUQU_TSAN_CANARY=1, so scripts/check_thread_sanitizer.sh can require a race report and a failed run before trusting a clean suite.
types: ThreadSanitizerCanaryTests.UnsynchronizedCounter: class (private, @unchecked Sendable) — an Int written without synchronization
state: env:EMUQU_TSAN_CANARY (passed by the gate as TEST_RUNNER_EMUQU_TSAN_CANARY)

units.does: Returns at once unless EMUQU_TSAN_CANARY is "1". Otherwise increments one UnsynchronizedCounter from 1,000 concurrentPerform iterations with no lock (a data race Thread Sanitizer reports, and with halt_on_error=1 ends the host on), and fails the test if the writes run to the end.
units.entry: XCTest runner; run on its own by scripts/check_thread_sanitizer.sh with TEST_RUNNER_EMUQU_TSAN_CANARY=1, and inertly in every other EmuquTests run.

branches.effect: false: return (no race); true: race, then XCTFail if not stopped
